def ci_yaml(site_path: str, include_links: bool, latest: bool) -> str:
    installer = "https://github.com/axodotdev/oranda/releases/latest/download/oranda-installer.sh" if latest else "https://github.com/axodotdev/oranda/releases/download/v0.6.1/oranda-installer.sh"
    link_block = LINK_BLOCK if include_links else "\n"
    return CI_TEMPLATE.format(installer_url=installer, site_path=site_path, link_block=link_block)


def prompt_bool(question: str, default: bool, hint: Optional[str] = None) -> bool:
    suffix = "(Y/n)" if default else "(y/N)"
    while True:
        sys.stdout.write(f"? >o_o< {question} {suffix}  ")
        sys.stdout.flush()
        if hint:
            # Keep this simple; observed TTY output includes the hint on a coloured line.
            pass
        ans = sys.stdin.readline()
        if ans == "":
            return default
        ans = ans.strip().lower()
        if not ans:
            val = default
            break
        if ans in ("y", "yes"):
            val = True
            break
        if ans in ("n", "no"):
            val = False
            break
    sys.stdout.write(f"> {question} {'Yes' if val else 'No'}\n")
    sys.stdout.flush()
    return val


def generate_notty_panic(state: State) -> None:
    if state.output_format == "json":
        out(app_json_diag("oranda panicked.", causes=["at src/generate.rs:56:14", "Error while prompting!: NotTTY"], help_text="set the `RUST_BACKTRACE=1` environment variable to display a backtrace."))
    err("  × oranda panicked.")
    err("  ├─▶ at src/generate.rs:56:14")
    err("  ╰─▶ Error while prompting!: NotTTY")
    if os.environ.get("RUST_BACKTRACE") == "1":
        # Addresses are intentionally fake but keep the visual style.
        for i in range(27):
            if i == 24:
                err(f"        {i:2}: 0x000000000000 - __libc_start_main")
            elif i == 26:
                err("        26:        0x0 - <unresolved>")
            else:
                err(f"        {i:2}: 0x000000000000 - <unresolved>")
    err("  help: set the `RUST_BACKTRACE=1` environment variable to display a backtrace.\n")
    raise CliExit(255)


def run_generate_ci(state: State, *, output_path: Optional[str], site_path: Optional[str]) -> None:
    out(INFO + "Generating a CI deploy workflow for your site...")
    if not sys.stdin.isatty():
        generate_notty_panic(state)
    include = prompt_bool("Do you want to include a tool for checking generated hyperlinks?", True,
                          "Read more about the link checker tool: https://github.com/untitaker/hyperlink")
    latest = prompt_bool("Do you want to always use the latest version of oranda?", False,
                         "Using the latest version means you don't have to rerun this command when oranda updates, but it may also break your site if you use a lot of configuration!")
    append_gitignore = prompt_bool("Would you like to append the default destination directory (`public`) to your .gitignore file?", False)
    out_path = Path(output_path or "web.yml")
    site = site_path or "public"
    out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out_path.write_text(ci_yaml(site, include, latest), encoding="utf-8")
    if append_gitignore:
        with open(".gitignore", "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write("\n# Generated by `oranda generate ci`\npublic/")
    out(SUCCESS + f"Wrote CI file to \"{str(out_path)}\"")

def parse_build(args: List[str], state: State) -> None:
    json_only = False
    i = 0
    help_kind: Optional[str] = None
    while i < len(args):
        tok = args[i]
        gi = parse_global_token(args, i, state, usage="executable build [OPTIONS]")
        if gi is not None:
            i = gi; continue
        if tok == "--help":
            help_kind = "long"; i += 1; continue
        if tok == "-h":
            help_kind = "short"; i += 1; continue
        if tok == "--json-only":
            if json_only:
                cli_error("the argument '--json-only' cannot be used multiple times", "executable build [OPTIONS]")
            json_only = True; i += 1; continue
        if tok.startswith("-"):
            cli_error(f"unexpected argument '{tok}' found", "executable build [OPTIONS]")
        cli_error(f"unexpected argument '{tok}' found", "executable build [OPTIONS]")
    if help_kind:
        print_to(sys.stdout, BUILD_LONG if help_kind == "long" else BUILD_SHORT)
        return
    run_build(state, json_only=json_only)


def parse_serve(args: List[str], state: State) -> None:
    port = 7979
    port_seen = False
    i = 0
    help_kind: Optional[str] = None
    while i < len(args):
        tok = args[i]
        gi = parse_global_token(args, i, state, usage="executable serve [OPTIONS]")
        if gi is not None:
            i = gi; continue
        if tok == "--help": help_kind = "long"; i += 1; continue
        if tok == "-h": help_kind = "short"; i += 1; continue
        if tok == "--port":
            if port_seen:
                cli_error("the argument '--port <PORT>' cannot be used multiple times", "executable serve [OPTIONS]")
            if i + 1 >= len(args):
                cli_error("a value is required for '--port <PORT>' but none was supplied", None)
            if args[i+1].startswith("-"):
                cli_error(f"unexpected argument '{args[i+1]}' found", "executable serve [OPTIONS]")
            port = parse_port_value(args[i+1], "--port <PORT>", "executable serve [OPTIONS]")
            port_seen = True; i += 2; continue
        if tok.startswith("--port="):
            if port_seen:
                cli_error("the argument '--port <PORT>' cannot be used multiple times", "executable serve [OPTIONS]")
            val = tok.split("=",1)[1]
            port = parse_port_value(val, "--port <PORT>", "executable serve [OPTIONS]")
            port_seen = True; i += 1; continue
        if tok.startswith("-"):
            cli_error(f"unexpected argument '{tok}' found", "executable serve [OPTIONS]")
        cli_error(f"unexpected argument '{tok}' found", "executable serve [OPTIONS]")
    if help_kind:
        print_to(sys.stdout, SERVE_LONG if help_kind == "long" else SERVE_SHORT)
        return
    run_serve(state, port=port)


def parse_dev(args: List[str], state: State) -> None:
    port = 7979
    port_seen = False
    no_first = False
    includes: List[str] = []
    i = 0
    help_kind: Optional[str] = None
    while i < len(args):
        tok = args[i]
        gi = parse_global_token(args, i, state, usage="executable dev [OPTIONS]")
        if gi is not None:
            i = gi; continue
        if tok == "--help": help_kind = "long"; i += 1; continue
        if tok == "-h": help_kind = "short"; i += 1; continue
        if tok == "--port":
            if port_seen:
                cli_error("the argument '--port <PORT>' cannot be used multiple times", "executable dev [OPTIONS]")
            if i + 1 >= len(args):
                cli_error("a value is required for '--port <PORT>' but none was supplied", None)
            if args[i+1].startswith("-"):
                cli_error(f"unexpected argument '{args[i+1]}' found", "executable dev [OPTIONS]")
            port = parse_port_value(args[i+1], "--port <PORT>", "executable dev [OPTIONS]")
            port_seen = True; i += 2; continue
        if tok.startswith("--port="):
            if port_seen:
                cli_error("the argument '--port <PORT>' cannot be used multiple times", "executable dev [OPTIONS]")
            val = tok.split("=",1)[1]
            port = parse_port_value(val, "--port <PORT>", "executable dev [OPTIONS]")
            port_seen = True; i += 1; continue
        if tok == "--no-first-build":
            if no_first:
                cli_error("the argument '--no-first-build' cannot be used multiple times", "executable dev [OPTIONS]")
            no_first = True; i += 1; continue
        if tok in ("-i", "--include-paths"):
            opt = "--include-paths <INCLUDE_PATHS>" if tok == "--include-paths" else "--include-paths <INCLUDE_PATHS>"
            if i + 1 >= len(args) or args[i+1].startswith("-"):
                cli_error(f"a value is required for '{opt}' but none was supplied", None)
            includes.append(args[i+1]); i += 2; continue
        if tok.startswith("--include-paths="):
            includes.append(tok.split("=",1)[1]); i += 1; continue
        if tok.startswith("-"):
            cli_error(f"unexpected argument '{tok}' found", "executable dev [OPTIONS]")
        cli_error(f"unexpected argument '{tok}' found", "executable dev [OPTIONS]")
    if help_kind:
        print_to(sys.stdout, DEV_LONG if help_kind == "long" else DEV_SHORT)
        return
    cfg, found = load_config(state)
    if state.verbose and not found:
        out(DEBUG + "No config found, using default values")
    if not no_first:
        # Do a local build as the first build. (The original can block on CSS.)
        run_build(state, json_only=False, internal=True)
    seen = []
    for p in includes:
        if p not in seen and Path(p).exists():
            seen.append(p)
    out(INFO + f"Found {len(seen)} paths to watch, starting watch...")
    if state.verbose:
        quoted = ", ".join(json.dumps(x) for x in seen)
        out(DEBUG + f"Files watched: [{quoted}]")
    dist = Path(dist_dir_from_config(cfg))
    prefix = path_prefix_from_config(cfg)
    out(SUCCESS + f"Your project is available at: {serve_url(port, prefix, trailing_for_empty=False)}")
    if not dist.exists():
        # Observed dev keeps running after a task panic; emit the panic and then idle.
        err("  × oranda panicked.")
        err("  ├─▶ at src/commands/dev.rs:131:62")
        err(f"  ╰─▶ called `Result::unwrap()` on an `Err` value: BuildNotFound {{ dist_dir: \"{dist_dir_from_config(cfg)}\" }}")
        err("  help: set the `RUST_BACKTRACE=1` environment variable to display a backtrace.\n")
        while True:
            time.sleep(3600)
    serve_forever(dist, prefix, port, livereload=True)


def parse_generate_ci_args(args: List[str], state: State, inherited_output: Optional[str], inherited_site: Optional[str]) -> None:
    output_path = inherited_output
    site_path = inherited_site
    ci = "github"
    ci_seen = False
    output_seen = output_path is not None
    site_seen = site_path is not None
    i = 0
    help_kind: Optional[str] = None
    while i < len(args):
        tok = args[i]
        gi = parse_global_token(args, i, state, usage="executable generate ci [OPTIONS]")
        if gi is not None:
            i = gi; continue
        if tok == "--help": help_kind = "long"; i += 1; continue
        if tok == "-h": help_kind = "short"; i += 1; continue
        if tok in ("-o", "--output-path"):
            if output_seen:
                cli_error("the argument '--output-path <OUTPUT_PATH>' cannot be used multiple times", "executable generate ci [OPTIONS]")
            if i + 1 >= len(args) or args[i+1].startswith("-"):
                cli_error("a value is required for '--output-path <OUTPUT_PATH>' but none was supplied", None)
            output_path = args[i+1]; output_seen = True; i += 2; continue
        if tok.startswith("--output-path="):
            if output_seen:
                cli_error("the argument '--output-path <OUTPUT_PATH>' cannot be used multiple times", "executable generate ci [OPTIONS]")
            output_path = tok.split("=",1)[1]; output_seen = True; i += 1; continue
        if tok in ("-s", "--site-path"):
            if site_seen:
                cli_error("the argument '--site-path <SITE_PATH>' cannot be used multiple times", "executable generate ci [OPTIONS]")
            if i + 1 >= len(args) or args[i+1].startswith("-"):
                cli_error("a value is required for '--site-path <SITE_PATH>' but none was supplied", None)
            site_path = args[i+1]; site_seen = True; i += 2; continue
        if tok.startswith("--site-path="):
            if site_seen:
                cli_error("the argument '--site-path <SITE_PATH>' cannot be used multiple times", "executable generate ci [OPTIONS]")
            site_path = tok.split("=",1)[1]; site_seen = True; i += 1; continue
        if tok == "--ci":
            if ci_seen:
                cli_error("the argument '--ci <CI>' cannot be used multiple times", "executable generate ci [OPTIONS]")
            if i + 1 >= len(args) or args[i+1].startswith("-"):
                cli_error("a value is required for '--ci <CI>' but none was supplied\n  [possible values: github]", None)
            val = args[i+1]
            if val != "github":
                cli_error(f"invalid value '{val}' for '--ci <CI>'\n  [possible values: github]\n\n  tip: a similar value exists: 'github'", None)
            ci = val; ci_seen = True; i += 2; continue
        if tok.startswith("--ci="):
            if ci_seen:
                cli_error("the argument '--ci <CI>' cannot be used multiple times", "executable generate ci [OPTIONS]")
            val = tok.split("=",1)[1]
            if val != "github":
                cli_error(f"invalid value '{val}' for '--ci <CI>'\n  [possible values: github]\n\n  tip: a similar value exists: 'github'", None)
            ci = val; ci_seen = True; i += 1; continue
        if tok.startswith("-"):
            cli_error(f"unexpected argument '{tok}' found", "executable generate ci [OPTIONS]")
        cli_error(f"unexpected argument '{tok}' found", "executable generate ci [OPTIONS]")
    if help_kind:
        print_to(sys.stdout, CI_LONG if help_kind == "long" else CI_SHORT)
        return
    run_generate_ci(state, output_path=output_path, site_path=site_path)


def parse_generate(args: List[str], state: State) -> None:
    output_path: Optional[str] = None
    site_path: Optional[str] = None
    output_seen = False
    site_seen = False
    i = 0
    help_kind: Optional[str] = None
    while i < len(args):
        tok = args[i]
        gi = parse_global_token(args, i, state, usage="executable generate [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>")
        if gi is not None:
            i = gi; continue
        if tok == "--help": help_kind = "long"; i += 1; continue
        if tok == "-h": help_kind = "short"; i += 1; continue
        if tok in ("-o", "--output-path"):
            # If help later at parent level, clap short-circuits before duplicate validation;
            # for normal execution keep duplicate checks.
            if output_seen:
                # Delay if a help flag appears later and no subcommand yet.
                if "--help" in args[i+1:] or "-h" in args[i+1:]:
                    pass
                else:
                    cli_error("the argument '--output-path <OUTPUT_PATH>' cannot be used multiple times", "executable generate [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>")
            if i + 1 >= len(args) or args[i+1].startswith("-"):
                cli_error("a value is required for '--output-path <OUTPUT_PATH>' but none was supplied", None)
            output_path = args[i+1]; output_seen = True; i += 2; continue
        if tok.startswith("--output-path="):
            if output_seen:
                cli_error("the argument '--output-path <OUTPUT_PATH>' cannot be used multiple times", "executable generate [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>")
            output_path = tok.split("=",1)[1]; output_seen = True; i += 1; continue
        if tok in ("-s", "--site-path"):
            if site_seen:
                cli_error("the argument '--site-path <SITE_PATH>' cannot be used multiple times", "executable generate [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>")
            if i + 1 >= len(args) or args[i+1].startswith("-"):
                cli_error("a value is required for '--site-path <SITE_PATH>' but none was supplied", None)
            site_path = args[i+1]; site_seen = True; i += 2; continue
        if tok.startswith("--site-path="):
            if site_seen:
                cli_error("the argument '--site-path <SITE_PATH>' cannot be used multiple times", "executable generate [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>")
            site_path = tok.split("=",1)[1]; site_seen = True; i += 1; continue
        if tok == "help":
            rest = args[i+1:]
            if rest and rest[0] == "ci":
                print_to(sys.stdout, CI_LONG); return
            print_to(sys.stdout, GENERATE_LONG); return
        if tok == "ci":
            parse_generate_ci_args(args[i+1:], state, output_path, site_path)
            return
        if tok.startswith("-"):
            cli_error(f"unexpected argument '{tok}' found", "executable generate [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>")
        cli_error(f"unrecognized subcommand '{tok}'", "executable generate [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>")
    if help_kind:
        print_to(sys.stdout, GENERATE_LONG if help_kind == "long" else GENERATE_SHORT)
        return
    print_to(sys.stderr, GENERATE_SHORT)
    raise CliExit(2)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main dispatch


def handle_help_command(args: List[str], state: State) -> None:
    if not args:
        print_to(sys.stdout, TOP_LONG); return
    first = args[0]
    if first == "build": print_to(sys.stdout, BUILD_LONG); return
    if first == "dev": print_to(sys.stdout, DEV_LONG); return
    if first == "serve": print_to(sys.stdout, SERVE_LONG); return
    if first == "generate":
        if len(args) > 1 and args[1] == "ci": print_to(sys.stdout, CI_LONG)
        else: print_to(sys.stdout, GENERATE_LONG)
        return
    cli_error(f"unrecognized subcommand '{first}'", "executable help [COMMAND]...")


def main(argv: List[str]) -> int:
    state = State()
    if not argv:
        print_to(sys.stderr, TOP_SHORT)
        return 2
    i = 0
    while i < len(argv):
        tok = argv[i]
        gi = parse_global_token(argv, i, state, usage="executable [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>")
        if gi is not None:
            i = gi; continue
        if tok == "--help":
            print_to(sys.stdout, TOP_LONG); return 0
        if tok == "-h":
            print_to(sys.stdout, TOP_SHORT); return 0
        if tok in ("--version", "-V"):
            out(VERSION); return 0
        if tok == "help":
            handle_help_command(argv[i+1:], state); return 0
        if tok == "build":
            parse_build(argv[i+1:], state); return 0
        if tok == "serve":
            parse_serve(argv[i+1:], state); return 0
        if tok == "dev":
            parse_dev(argv[i+1:], state); return 0
        if tok == "generate":
            parse_generate(argv[i+1:], state); return 0
        if tok.startswith("-"):
            cli_error(f"unexpected argument '{tok}' found", "executable [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>")
        cli_error(f"unrecognized subcommand '{tok}'", "executable [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>")
    print_to(sys.stderr, TOP_SHORT)
    return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
    except CliExit as e:
        raise SystemExit(e.code)
    except BrokenPipeError:
        raise SystemExit(1)
